name: TomoSphero Raytracer
definition: A differentiable raytracer for planetary and solar tomography on spherical grids (radial, elevational, azimuthal) that precomputes ray-boundary intersections to accelerate iterative reconstruction.
summary: TomoSphero is a differentiable raytracer for tomographic reconstruction on spherical grids, distinguished by its explicit handling of spherical, conical, and planar boundaries for planetary atmospheric modeling.
